annotation.title_clean: 国土交通省関係地域再生法施行規則
annotation.title_en: Ordinance for Enforcement of the Act on Regional Revitalization, Relating to the Ministry of Land, Infrastructure, Transport and Tourism
annotation.authors_or_issuer: Ministry of Land, Infrastructure, Transport and Tourism (Japan)
annotation.summary_en: Japanese MLIT ministerial ordinance implementing the Regional Revitalization Act: land-use notifications, housing-estate regeneration plans, registration of paid private passenger transport, and freight consolidation approvals. Only passing mention of automated driving passenger transport (自動運行装置, 特定自動運行) in application documents.
key_provisions_or_claims: Specifies notification forms and attachments for development and building acts under regional land-use plans
Requires plans for housing-estate private paid passenger transport to describe automated-operation passenger transport and its operating conditions
Requires documentation of the permit prospects for specified automated operation under the Road Traffic Act
Establishes registration and certificate procedures for housing-estate paid passenger transport operators
Delegates ministerial powers to regional transport bureau heads
